clips.title: The story
paras: Farren's Proof is an Alliance assignment in Southshore given by Lieutenant Farren Orinelle. Tasked with proving his coastal patrol efforts to his superior, Marshal Redpath, Farren sends recruits out to harvest severed murloc heads along the Western Strand.

Following initial sweeps along the coastline in Down the Coast, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle finds himself under scrutiny by Marshal Redpath and town leadership. Claiming credit for clearing out the local murlocs is one thing; presenting undeniable evidence to skeptical superiors is quite another. Unwilling to soil his own hands with gruesome butchery, Farren tasks wandering Alliance adventurers with returning to the shoreline to collect tangible proof of the kill.

The task takes fighters west of Southshore along the Western Strand, where coastal murlocs nest along the shallows. The lieutenant requires ten severed murloc heads to appease the town garrison's officers. Farren himself detests the creatures, admitting that the repulsive sight and smell of amphibious fish-men has utterly ruined his appetite for Southshore's primary export and staple food.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Redpath wasn't satisfied with all the murlocs we killed—oh now, don't be modest, you had some hand in it.
Now he wants me to bring proof of the dead, hacking off cold, slimy murloc heads to submit for his approval.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get those heads for me, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh for the Love of the Light... They're dripping on the ground.
Can't stand touching those things, myself. Fish are all well and good, but when they grow legs and start walking around...
Haven't eaten a fish in weeks, let me tell you, and in Southshore, that means you aren't eating much.
